title: 第九章 虚界第十章 天堑
content_zh:
早自习上完。
第一节课是灵能工业课。
高考总分750分。
综合修为，考核评级机械人偶实战占200分。
灵能工业课占150分。
修真道法解析，基础知识理论，丹道器道符道阵道基本原理，占100分。
武道，法术，道心，这三门课各占100分。
看似对境界的硬性要求不高，但没到炼气中期四层，只会被考核人偶给打爆。
去年灰核城，俗称灰大的录取分数线是701分，是苍州排名前五的大学。
这意味着各个科目都要臻至完美，然后在实战中不被打爆撑一分钟，才考得上。
灵能工业课虽是理论课，但也是重中之重，虽优先级在实战之下，但却是现如今方舱的发展根本。
这个科目每年都还有专门的高校联赛，获得优异成绩者，甚至能够保送。
教学楼。
应届三班的多媒体教室内。
王庆有着过目不忘，一心多用的能力，所谓的灵能工业课，在高校只是靠死记硬背的东西。
早就背完了。
所以昨天王庆也懂点root之类的词汇。
高校也只讲最基本的而已，灵能义体的一般常识和结构，灵能机械的控制程序基本代码，等等。
要比起莫振雄那种在道上都能吃得开的，是天壤之别。
灵能工业课的老师是个戴眼睛的老学究，用ppt文档讲解着主流操作系统中机械义体手臂的神经指令代码。

问题在于，教材里所谓的主流操作系统已经是远远落后于时代的了，那些垄断级别的义体巨头，技术保密程度极度可怕。
也就是拿给学生了解了解基本构筑而已。
王庆为了出勤率才来上课，依然坐在教室末尾，依然线上娱乐。
今晚。
他不会去交易现场。
但到最后他还是会去。
王庆深知，自己提炼出的修士精粹，纯度极高，杂质控制在1%以下。
人炼出来的东西，自然是要作为“寿丹”、“魂丹”这些邪道丹药的药引。
药引是关系到丹药整体强度最关键的一部分。
他不是很懂方舱里的平均纯度多高，如果都比自己高的话，当自己没说。
匿名制药公司的掮客叫做萧肃。
content_en:
Finish your self-study early.
The first class is a psychic industry class.
The total score of the college entrance examination is 750 points.
Comprehensive cultivation level, assessment and rating of mechanical doll actual combat will account for 200 points.
The psychic industry course accounts for 150 points.
Analysis of cultivation methods, basic knowledge theory, and basic principles of alchemy, tools, symbols, formations, and formations, accounting for 100 points.
Martial Arts, Spells, and Taoist Mind, these three courses each account for 100 points.
It seems that the hard requirements for the realm are not high, but if you don't reach the fourth level of the middle stage of Qi refining, you will only be blown up by the assessment doll.
Last year, the admission score of Gray Core City, commonly known as Gray University, was 701, making it one of the top five universities in Cangzhou.
This means that each subject must be perfected, and then you must last for one minute without being beaten in actual combat in order to pass the exam.
Although the psychic industry course is a theoretical course, it is also a top priority. Although the priority is lower than actual combat, it is the foundation for the development of today's shelter.
There is a special college league for this subject every year, and those who get excellent results can even be recommended.
Teaching building.
In the multimedia classroom of the third class of fresh graduates.
Wang Qing has a photographic memory and the ability to multi-task. The so-called psychic industry courses in colleges and universities are just things that are memorized by rote.
I’ve finished memorizing it a long time ago.
So yesterday Wang Qing also knew some words like root.
Colleges and universities only teach the most basic ones, such as general knowledge and structure of psionic prosthetics, basic codes of control programs for psionic machines, etc.
Compared to Mo Zhenxiong, who can enjoy everything on the road, it is a world of difference.
The teacher of the psychic industry class is an old scholar wearing glasses, using ppt documents to explain the neural command code of the mechanical prosthetic arm in the mainstream operating system.
The problem is that the so-called mainstream operating systems in the textbooks are already far behind the times. Those monopoly-level prosthetic giants have extremely terrible levels of technical secrecy.
That is to say, it is just for students to understand the basic structure.
Wang Qing only came to class for the sake of attendance. He still sat at the end of the classroom and continued to entertain online.
tonight.
He will not go to the transaction site.
But in the end he will go.
Wang Qing knew very well that the monk essence he extracted was extremely pure, with impurities controlled below 1%.
The things that people refine are naturally used as medicinal ingredients for evil elixirs such as "Shou Dan" and "Soul Dan".
The medicine guide is the most critical part related to the overall strength of the elixir.
He didn't quite understand how high the average purity was in the cabin. If it was higher than himself, just pretend he didn't say anything.
The broker of the anonymous pharmaceutical company is named Xiao Su.
